name: shelfguessr
title: shelfguessr
blurb: geoguessr, but the map is your simcluster and the location is a bookshelf: upload a photo of yours, then guess whose shelf you're looking at from your mutuals who've done the same. correct guesses climb a network-wide leaderboard. asked for by gracekind.net, off a thread about zooming in on someone's bookshelf photo for book recs.
